description: Implementation of a queue data structure with functions to create, push, pop, and destroy queues, including conditional compilation for dynamic or static queue management.

methods.name: createQ
methods.description: Creates a new queue instance and initializes its parameters.

methods.name: pushToQ
methods.description: Adds an element to the queue if not full.

methods.name: popFromQ
methods.description: Removes and returns an element from the queue if not empty.

methods.name: destroyQ
methods.description: Destroys a queue instance and frees associated memory.
